sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; OSReward was rejected as already published and SafeFlow selected from the same table.
Main agent read the arXiv v2 paper, extracted methodology, experiments, ablations, confidence intervals, adaptive attacks, and failure boundaries.
Checked the official GitHub research release and a related Microsoft IFC discussion to frame implementation and reproducibility boundaries.
Marked runtime observability, provenance edges, authorization metadata, defense-side injection, and research-release reproducibility as limits.
Article uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external images are embedded.
